dialect.rfc.about: As the RFC writes it: lowercase operations, real booleans, a path on every operation, a new group's members in its POST, and a PATCH of exactly what changed.
dialect.entra.about: Looks users and groups up by name before creating them, capitalises operations, sends booleans as "True" and "False", writes the address through emails[type eq "work"].value, fills new groups afterwards and removes members by naming them in the value.
dialect.okta.about: Looks users and groups up before creating them, replaces the whole user with PUT on every change of profile, switches users with a PATCH without path, renames groups by sending them back with their id, and removes members one filtered path at a time.
